in_marathi.name: Gopalakrishnan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of Cows and God Krishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopalakrishnan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gopala refers to 'protector of cows'. Krishna means 'all-attractive'. Thus, Gopalakrishnan signifies one who protects and embodies the divine qualities of Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Gopalakrishnan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector of Cows and God Krishna
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gopalakrishnan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Gopala refers to 'protector of cows'. Krishna means 'all-attractive'. Thus, Gopalakrishnan signifies one who protects and embodies the divine qualities of Krishna.
